## Description

#765 wired the WF2 Step-3 competitive design bake-off (engine run-identity plumbing, the workflow-callable `bakeoff_policy.py design-round` CLI with `--winner-out`/`--evidence-out`, one live proving round, Step-3 prose + the `designBakeoff.enabled` opt-in gate — **default OFF** by owner decision 2026-07-31). The mechanics are proven: two candidates head-to-head on separate quota pools, glm judge, winner's exact bytes retrievable, both candidates' info recorded (raw → gitignored sink, sanitized → committable evidence).

What is NOT yet true — the gap between "the CLI works" and "a real WF2 run uses it":

1. **Environment bootstrap is manual.** The round needs `ZHIPUAI_API_KEY` (from `~/.config/rawgentic/glm-judge.env`) and a zhipuai-capable python (today: the workspace `.venv-bench`). A session running the documented command under plain `python3` gets a fail-loud exit 3 (judge unavailable) — honest, but a failed round. The CLI should self-bootstrap: source the judge env file if present, locate/verify a zhipuai-capable interpreter, and give a one-line actionable error naming the missing prerequisite.
2. **No real child has run it as its actual design mechanism.** The #765 proving rounds used test briefs. One opted-in WF2 child must run Step 3 through the round with the winner's bytes becoming the actual design draft (`--winner-out` → the Step-3 artifact) and the sanitized evidence riding that child's PR.
3. **Per-run evidence convention.** #765 committed a one-off evidence artifact; adopted runs need a naming/location convention (e.g. `docs/measurements/bakeoff-<issue>-<correlation>.json`) plus a run-record hook so bake-off value becomes measurable per child (the A/B evidence the retire/re-open path wants).
4. **Default-on decision.** After 1–3 land and a few opted-in children accumulate evidence, bring the owner a default-ON proposal with the measured cost/benefit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `design-round` self-bootstraps the judge env (env file + interpreter check) with actionable failures
- [ ] One real opted-in WF2 child ships with the round as its Step-3 mechanism (winner bytes = design draft; sanitized evidence in its PR)
- [ ] Per-run evidence naming convention documented + wired into the run-record
- [ ] Default-on proposal presented to the owner with measured evidence (explicitly owner-gated)

## Provenance

Filed from #765 during the epic #756 auto-run (owner mid-run decision 2026-07-31: "focus on being able to disable it, then harden and make it run later as a follow-up"). Depends on #765.
